name: freeform-council
title: Freeform Council
summary: Open-ended multi-provider council session where providers collaborate through structured turns without a fixed workflow template. Supports round-robin, mention-driven, and adaptive turn policies for flexible multi-model collaboration.
when_to_use: When you need open-ended multi-model discussion without a predetermined workflow structure
When exploring a problem space that does not fit a specific workflow template
When you want providers to collaborate freely with configurable turn-taking policies

inputs.name: turn-policy
inputs.description: Turn-taking policy: round_robin (default), mention_driven, or adaptive.

inputs.name: max-turns
inputs.description: Maximum number of council turns before session ends. Defaults to coordination config value.

steps: InitializeCouncil: Set up multi-provider session with the selected turn policy
CouncilTurns (iterated): Providers take turns responding according to the turn policy until max turns or natural conclusion
MaterializeSummary: Produce a summary of the council discussion and any decisions reached
outputs: Summary document with key decisions and action items
